user_story: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: Register with a new, unused email
steps: Enter a new email address that is not in the system.
Fill in the rest of the registration details.
positive.expected_result: User is successfully registered and redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Attempt to register with an already-used email
steps: Enter an email address that is known to already exist in the system.
Fill in the rest of the registration details.
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message indicating the email is already in use and cannot proceed.

edge.title: Attempt to register with an email identical except for case
steps: Enter an email address that matches an existing one in the system except for case differences (e.g., "Test@Email.com" when "test@email.com" exists).
Fill in the rest of the registration details.
edge.expected_result: User receives an error message indicating the email is already in use regardless of case sensitivity.
